item.title: Version 0.1.21
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.21 — Restart onboarding actually restarts.
Clicking Settings → Restart onboarding was re-opening the window but the SwiftUI Window scene reuses the existing OnboardingView instance, so its @State `step` lingered at 7 (the Done screen) from the previous run. You ended up looking at the Finish button with no way to walk through the steps again.
The Settings button now bumps a shared restart token; OnboardingView observes the token and resets to step 1 plus the per-run state (suggestion seed flag, coach key draft, race toggle). Per-user prefs that should survive (unit, metric, prior targets) are intentionally untouched.
